earnings.title: Rocket Companies Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Generated Q3'26 total revenue, net of $3.28 billion and adjusted revenue of $2.57 billion.
Reported Q3'26 GAAP net income of $709 million and adjusted net income of $419 million.

quotes.text: Rocket gained market share in both purchase and refinance, quarter over quarter and year over year, and delivered our highest profitability margin in nearly five years, even as mortgage rates climbed to a three-year high.
quotes.by: Varun Krishna, CEO and Director of Rocket Companies

outlook: In Q4 2026, we expect adjusted revenue between $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion.

items.heading: The success and growth of our business, results of operations and financial condition will depend upon our continued ability to adapt to and implement technological changes to meet our business needs and the changing demands of the market and our clients.
